g.title: setup
g.text: Current Steer configuration / process runtime / Aiterm provider

g.title: profile
g.text: product owns roots, schemas, entry names

g.title: process
g.text: PID / birth / lineage; PS7 and Node identity
quoted argv; no configuration on mere import

g.title: plan
g.text: preserve other hooks + own insertion location
calculate moved and vacated trust keys

g.title: cc
g.text: recognize old/new own entry with filename boundary

g.title: provider
g.text: invalid explicit target: refuse, no fallback

g.title: binary
g.text: missing saved binary: rediscover + product config write

g.title: call
g.text: Spawn provider CLI once; stdin body
validate last stdout JSON schema / ok

g.title: os
g.text: POSIX ps / Windows PS7 (.NET; WMI where required)

g.title: apply
g.text: clean vacated keys; approve own hook via official API

g.title: saved
g.text: Save product hook config + stale PID/birth set

g.title: unknown
g.text: preserve existing errors and effect distinctions

g.title: result
g.text: lineage failure: existing fallback or partial result

g.title: failure
g.text: terminal native read failure: ProcessTableError code=2
proposed safe suffix: component / probe / code / status / signal / bytes
no raw argv, command, error message, stdout, stderr retained

g.title: display
g.text: CLI JSON / hook stderr / Aiterm tool text
not a launch side-effect or recovery proof
